Name: Farmer Vitiligo
Author: xaandiir
Description:
[center][b]WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO[/b]

This mod changes the farmer base so there is a vitiligo pattern on the skin color.

[b]HOW TO INSTALL[/b]

- Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
- Download and unzip file
- Drop file into your "\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder
- Run game with SMAPI

*Mod is automatically set to default to Vitiligo_1 (mostly dark skin with patches of light skin) but can be configured to Vitiligo_2 (mostly light skin with patches of dark skin).*

[b]HOW TO CONFIGURE[/b]
-Mod is set default to all 4 bases being inactive (Masc, Fem, Masc Bald, and Fem Bald, all set to False) with the light patches. These can be reconfigured.
-If you want light patches of skin, set to "Light". If you want dark patches of skin, set to "Dark".
-Make sure you set the correct base to apply to your character.
-Open config.json file in a software like Notepad
-Change the "Vitiligo" setting you want to "true" or "false", then to "Light" or "Dark".
-Save file, close file, change back to .json
-Run game with SMAPI

**Light works best on a dark skin default as the patches always show up as light.
**Dark works best on a light skin default as the patches always show up as dark.

[b]Note:[/b] The "bald" base refers to any of the hairstyles that show off the scalp. This includes completely bald, shaved down, mohawk, balding, etc.

[u]Feel free to ask if you have any questions![/u]

[b]Not compatible: 
-Any XNB files that replace farmer_base. (This mod will override it.) 
-Any CP mods that replace the farmer_base XNB. (Overlay CPs are uncertain atm)[/b][b]
[/b][/center]
